projects.title: Personal Portfolio AI Assistant
projects.description: An interactive chatbot portfolio built using the Vercel AI SDK and Gemini 2.0 Flash to answer questions based on static resume context.
highlights: Implemented strict system prompting to eliminate model hallucinations.
Handled edge-case HTTP status codes including 400 and 429 rate limits.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Why did you build an AI assistant for your portfolio?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: To provide recruiters and visitors with an instant, interactive way to query my background, skills, and metrics without scrolling through a traditional static resume.
